summary: Fixed the packaging build failing with "cannot find the batch label specified" by keeping build batch files on CRLF line endings.
details: cmd.exe resolves `call :label` by byte offset and cannot find labels in LF-only batch files once the label sits past a certain position.
Repository batch files are now normalized to CRLF and pinned there by .gitattributes.
Workspace preparation also normalizes batch line endings, so a ZIP or local workspace can no longer inherit the failure.
